draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Thiruvalla! The Thiruvatta Mahadeva Temple here is mentioned in the Vazhappally inscription, the earliest known record of a Kodungallur Chera king, written in Malayalam. Today the town is called the healthcare city and banking capital of Kerala.
draft.hungryLine: Thiruvalla is the biggest town in the district, so there's plenty to eat. Ask around the KSRTC terminal for a good local meal.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk to St. John's Cathedral to see its round design, then head on to the Thiruvatta Mahadeva Temple on the river.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a quiet spot by the Manimala River, which the town sits beside.
moodReplies.surprise-me: St. John's Cathedral is circular, and it was designed by a British architect.

spots.name: Tiruvalla railway station
spots.detail: 11 min walk · The only railway station in Pathanamthitta district

spots.name: Thiruvatta Mahadeva Temple
spots.detail: Short drive · Ancient Shiva temple on the Manimalayar

legends.title: Parashurama's Shiva
legends.body: According to folklore, the sage Parashurama installed the Shiva idol here in the Treta Yuga. The temple sits on the banks of the Manimalayar.

legends.title: One of the 108
legends.body: This is counted among the 108 famous Shiva temples of Kerala. Devotees treat it as part of that old sacred circuit.

tips.title: Arrive by train.
tips.body: Tiruvalla is the district's only railway station, with daily trains to cities like Chennai, Bangalore and New Delhi.

tips.title: Use the KSRTC terminal.
tips.body: Buses run from the terminal near SCS Junction to Ernakulam, Thiruvananthapuram and beyond.

story.title: Written in stone
story.body: The Vazhappally inscription mentions the Thiruvatta temple. It is the earliest known record naming a Kodungallur Chera king, and it's in Malayalam.

story.title: An eight-bed clinic
story.body: Pushpagiri began as a tiny eight-bed clinic. It is now a 678-bed hospital.

story.title: A town of learning
story.body: MACFAST, a research institute, opened in 2001, and Pushpagiri became a teaching hospital in 2002.

story.title: Healthcare and banking
story.body: Thiruvalla is the largest town in the district and a big centre for finance, education and healthcare in central Travancore.
